The key insight: when your opponent sacrifices material with spite checks, look ahead one move further to your recapture. Black's checks are forced but don't win back material. This pattern—a tactical blow followed by forced but insufficient counterplay—wins by a tempo. Always calculate opponent checks to their end before moving.
